knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A spring that will not open fully is a defect. Remove from service, tag and report.
A needle is a puncture and biological hazard. Stop, keep others back, do not handle, and report.
Broken glass goes in a rigid, labelled, puncture-resistant container kept out of green waste.

practicalCriteria: Given three supplied hand tools with one defect, the learner identifies the defective tool, removes it from service, tags it and states the reason within the assessor's set time.
The learner demonstrates a controlled cut on a supplied stem with the free hand out of the cutting line and the fall zone clear.
The learner packages supplied simulated sharp waste into the correct containers without hand-sorting.
evidenceRequired: Tool inspection record signed by the assessor.
Assessor observation record of the cutting demonstration.
Packaging record for the simulated sharp waste.
stopWorkCriteria: A cut with the free hand inside the cutting line.
Use of a tool the assessor has marked defective.
Hand-sorting of the simulated sharp waste pile.
